sections.content: The simple future expresses predictions, expectations and future results. It is common when the speaker presents an event as expected rather than already arranged.

items.spanish: Si seguimos así, terminaremos antes del plazo.
items.english: If we keep going like this, we'll finish before the deadline.

items.spanish: Creo que el proyecto tendrá éxito porque cuenta con suficiente apoyo.
items.english: I think the project will succeed because it has enough support.
Will you arrive on time if you leave now?

items.spanish: No te preocupes: encontraremos una solución.
items.english: Don't worry: we'll find a solution.

sections.content: Choose the future form according to its function: intention, prediction, wish, condition or expected result.
